1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __2000 Da__ and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein said polyanion is __not limited to sodium polyvinyl sulfonate__.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker __selected from the group consisting of zirconium, aluminum, and titanium__.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __selected from the group consisting of polyethylenimine and polypropylenimine__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from __the group consisting of sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate, dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants__.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations __wherein at least one of said cations is selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium, or calcium ions__.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __nanoparticle has an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter, and is stable in water, field brine, and seawater__.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __selected from the group consisting of polyethylenimine and polypropylenimine__ and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __wherein said multivalent cation is selected from the group consisting of Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe, or Al__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising __a zirconium ion__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __that can be crosslinked with said composition__; and c) a fluid.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or N,N-dimethylacrylamide. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where __the fluid is selected from the group consisting of brine, seawater, and other aqueous fluids__.
